instrument: Oregon Data Center Advisory Committee, Preliminary Learnings and Questions Document (September 2026)
summary: The committee found that indirect water consumption from power generation can be multiple times larger than direct data center water use depending on the generation source, that low-water cooling raises grid load, that Oregon water is fully allocated, and that NDAs and municipal service create significant public data gaps on data center water use.
text: The Committee learned that indirect water consumption associated with electric power generation can be multiple times larger than direct data center water usage, depending on the generation source.

source.citation: Oregon Data Center Advisory Committee, Preliminary Learnings and Questions Document, September 2026 (released September 10, 2026)

notes: Addresses the open system-boundary question in the water register (closed-loop 'no water' claims versus boundary-dependent accounting). Consistent with the Scope 1/2/3 framing in the ECOnorthwest deck (July 31, 2026).
